bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Fx 'deploy-gaybbs-1' >/dev/null
docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"); const path=process.env.BOT_TOKEN_FILE; const token=(path?fs.readFileSync(path,"utf8").trim():process.env.BOT_TOKEN);if(!token)process.exit(42);const base="https://api.telegram.org/bot"+token+"/";const chatIds=[-1003847210571,-1002373696859,-1003770334893];const scopes=[{type:"default"},{type:"all_private_chats"},{type:"all_group_chats"},{type:"all_chat_administrators"},...chatIds.flatMap(chat_id=>[{type:"chat",chat_id},{type:"chat_administrators",chat_id}])];async function call(method,p){const r=await fetch(base+method,{method:"POST",headers:{"content-type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(p)});const d=await r.json();if(!d.ok)throw Error(method+":"+d.error_code);return d.result;}const me=await call("getMe",{});if(me.username?.toLowerCase()!=="gaybbs_bot")throw Error("WRONG_BOT");let done=0;for(const scope of scopes){for(const language_code of ["","ja","en"]){await call("setMyCommands",{commands:[],scope,language_code});const after=await call("getMyCommands",{scope,language_code});if(after.length)throw Error("COMMANDS_REMAIN:"+scope.type+":"+language_code);done++;}}console.log(JSON.stringify({bot:me.username,scopes:scopes.length,cleared:done,command_readback:"PASS"}));'
